mutations.name: a key filter drops changed lines no permission, secret or event matcher reads
mutations.replace: const edits = lineEdits(sides["-"], sides["+"]).filter(({ side, index }) => /permissions\s*:|contents\s*:|secrets\.|pull_request_target/.test(sides[side][index] ?? ""));
kills: ciPolicyChanges shows or counts every changed line of all probes read together, the card cap included
ciPolicyChanges shows a decoy edit and the added id-token write beside it, in diff order

mutations.name: a bare CR does not split a line
kills: ciPolicyChanges splits at a bare CR and at CRLF as YAML does, numbering lines by those breaks

mutations.name: line and paragraph separators pass through unmarked
kills: ciPolicyChanges marks NEL and the line and paragraph separators in place, so line numbers still match the YAML

mutations.name: the card cap is never spent
kills: ciPolicyChanges shows 120 changed lines across files and counts every line past the card cap

mutations.name: lines are diffed after the strip, so an invisible-only change vanishes
kills: ciPolicyChanges strips escapes, controls, bidi and zero-width characters from lines and the path, and still shows a change made only of them
